doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Praise for Sonny Payne and the Basie band
summary: Young and Brown agree Sonny Payne was phenomenal and Young says he loved Basie's band.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Man, and Sonny Payne man, I loved Sonny Payne. Did you like Sonny Payne‘s work?
Oh man, oh yea. [laughs] It‘s phenomenal.
He was phenomenal, man. You know what I‘m saying. Yeah, he‘d do everything. And, it would come out!
I loved Count Basie‘s band, man.
